start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-short-videos-from-footage on the clip I approved from yesterday's recording." It cuts the clip, adds captions, makes it vertical, renders it, picks a cover and checks the words against your rules.

lists.label: B-roll rules
lists.holds: One row per rule for what cutaway footage may be laid over a talking clip.

values.rule: Use a close shot of the hands when the person names a tool.
Use a wide shot of the place when the person starts a story.

lists.label: Word checks
lists.holds: One row per rule the person's words must pass before they go out, on or off.

values.rule: No word that promises a result nobody can promise.

lists.label: Setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting up, with whether it is done.

lists.label: Setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not finish and why.

values.gap: No b-roll rules yet, so no cutaway was picked.
The business facts row is missing.

instructions: 1. Run workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion through its facts step first, so record:business-setup:facts exists; this workflow stops and says so when it does not.

2. Pour the two example b-roll rules and the two example word checks into the lists you already keep (see pour), or make list:b-roll-rules and list:word-checks from them, then edit them to your own rules.
3. Pick the recording the clip comes from; the workflow lists your recordings and keeps each one's identity, and never downloads the file.
4. Say "Run workflow:make-short-videos-from-footage". It finds the pauses, proposes cuts, and you choose one clip of 15 to 60 seconds.
5. Read the captions it shows; the words are checked against list:word-checks, and any line that fails is shown to you with the rule it broke.
6. The finished clip is written as one record:short-clip row for the posting workflow to draft from; nothing is posted by this workflow.

worked_examples.title: A 30-second clip becomes a vertical short
worked_examples.ask: Make a short from the part where I name the first mistake.
worked_examples.given: A recording identity, from 312 to 342 seconds, and the timed words of that part.
worked_examples.hands_back: An edit cut from 312 to 342 seconds with one subtitle caption per timed word group; its identity (1f:<64 hex>) goes to reframe-vertical next.

worked_examples.title: The finished short is handed to the posting stage
worked_examples.ask: Hand the finished clip to posting.

value.caption: Stop practising what you already do well

worked_examples.given: A rendered identity and a cover identity from the two steps before.
worked_examples.hands_back: The record record:short-clip:clip-1, read back with the same values.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and one kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
